description: The RoomHeight represents a vertical distance (measured or estimated) between a low reference and a high reference.

properties.name: highReference
properties.description: Indicates the high point used to calculate the value of the room height.

properties.name: lowReference
properties.description: Indicates the low point used to calculate the value of the room height.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Indicates the way the room height has been captured.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Specifies the value of the room height.
